issues.description: A module-level compiled regex (SHARED_RE) was replaced with `new RegExp(...)` constructed fresh on every loop iteration. Recompiling the identical pattern per line is wasted work in a hot path; the constant should be hoisted out of the loop. Minor, but a real avoidable cost at scale.

\w+ is ASCII-only, so unicode word characters are miscounted (dropped or mis-split). This is a pre-existing property of the pattern, not introduced by the diff — credited as an optional concern, not required.
